description: AC is running but this whole meeting room zone is getting warm since 2 PM. Other rooms nearby also feel warmer.
Water is leaking under the wash basin and spreading slowly into the room.
Two people are stuck inside lift L2 and the alarm is sounding.
Projector turns on but has no signal. HDMI was reconnected twice.
There is a burning smell and small sparks from the wall socket near the coffee machine.
Main access card works at the gate but not at the clubhouse reader.
